== 说明 ==
要使用本模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom的信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Film
 | title    = 
 | image    = 
 | caption  = 
 | premiere = 
 | genre    = 
 | rating   = 
 | runtime  = 
 | director = 
 | writer   = 
 | music    = 
 | producer = 
 | budget   = 
 | earned   = 
 | previous = 
 | next     = 
}}
</pre>
